Context: 5. Reinstatement

- (8) Official's death while under suspension.
5. Period of suspension treated as non-duty (unless otherwise decided for any specific purpose).(1) In cases of departmental proceedings where the Government servant is not fully exonerated or the earlier order is set aside solely on the ground of non-compliance with the requirements of Article 311.
- (2) In Court cases under similar circumstances.
- (3) In cases where suspension is not considered wholly unjustified.
